base-100.$description: ---- Surfaces -------------------------------------------------------- */ /* base-100: page background. NHS White #FFFFFF — the canvas behind */ /* body copy, primary content cards, and dialog modals.

base-200.$description: base-200: secondary surface. NHS Inform Off-White #F0F4F5 — used */ /* on nhsinform.scot for the page wash behind the main column at */ /* wide breakpoints, and for summary / "at a glance" panels.

base-300.$description: base-300: tertiary surface. NHS Pale Grey #E8EDEE — divider rows, */ /* table zebra striping, list-row hover, and the "grey panel" used */ /* for sectioned navigation in NHS 24 service journeys.

base-content.$description: base-content: primary text. NHS Black #212B32 — warm near-black */ /* tuned to reduce on-screen glare for users reading long-form */ /* clinical content (a shared NHS UK / NHS Scotland choice).

primary.$description: ---- Primary (NHS Scotland Navy) ------------------------------------ */ /* NHS Scotland Navy #003087 (Pantone 287) — the flagship brand */ /* colour. Darker than NHS England's #005EB8: this is the single */ /* clearest visual signal that a service belongs to NHS Scotland */ /* rather than NHS England. Used on the NHS Scotland logo block, */ /* primary buttons, the global header band on nhsinform.scot, and */ /* the active state of primary nav.

secondary.$description: ---- Secondary (NHS Scotland Mid Blue) ------------------------------ */ /* NHS Scotland Mid Blue #0078D4 — the link colour on nhsinform.scot */ /* and the secondary-button fill on NHS 24 journeys. Sits between */ /* the navy primary and the bright accent so layered buttons keep a */ /* clear hierarchy without losing the NHS Scotland identity.

accent.$description: ---- Accent (NHS Aqua / Teal) --------------------------------------- */ /* NHS Aqua / Teal #00A499 — supplementary accent associated with */ /* NHS 24 chrome and used for illustrative chart series. Not for */ /* primary calls to action; reserve for decorative emphasis, */ /* category chips, and data visualisation.

neutral.$description: ---- Neutral -------------------------------------------------------- */ /* Neutral chrome (dark footer, NHS 24 dark cards, on-call signage). */ /* Mirrors base-content so dark blocks share the same warm near-black */ /* identity as body text, keeping the page visually coherent.

info.$description: ---- Info (NHS Bright Blue) ----------------------------------------- */ /* NHS Bright Blue #0072CE — informational banners ("did you know?", */ /* "your appointment is at…"), inline help, and link chips. Distinct */ /* from primary so message banners read as messages, not actions.

success.$description: ---- Success (NHS Green) -------------------------------------------- */ /* NHS Green #009639 — confirmation panels, completed-step indicators */ /* ("you have been booked"), and the success state on form summaries. */ /* Identical role and contrast target as the NHS UK system so shared */ /* components carry the same meaning across the border.

warning.$description: ---- Warning (NHS Warm Yellow) -------------------------------------- */ /* NHS Warm Yellow #FFB81C — caution banners and the canonical focus */ /* indicator. Yellow swatches are light, so the content colour MUST */ /* stay dark (≈ NHS Black) to clear WCAG AA contrast. Reusing this */ /* hue across NHS England, NHS Scotland, and NHS Wales is deliberate: */ /* keyboard users build muscle memory for "yellow means focus".

error.$description: ---- Error (NHS Emergency Services Red) ----------------------------- */ /* NHS Emergency Services Red #DA291C — validation errors, */ /* destructive actions, "phone 999" badges inside NHS Inform. */ /* Reserved for genuine errors and safety messages: the colour */ /* carries strong NHS meaning across both nations and must not be */ /* used for decorative emphasis.

selector.$description: ---- Geometry tokens (clinical / high-density) --------------------- */ /* Selectors (checkbox / radio): square per NHS frontend defaults so */ /* the tick / dot stays perfectly centred at every font size. Square */ /* selectors are doubly appropriate for clinical UI where checklist */ /* grids dominate (allergies, observations, problem-list flags).

field.$description: Form fields: 2px corners — sharper than the 4px patient theme. */ /* Clinical instruments traditionally use crisp rectangles; the small */ /* radius keeps a hint of softness so the UI doesn't read as hostile */ /* while still aligning more closely to EPR conventions.

box.$description: Card / panel / dialog: 2px corner radius. Tight corners keep */ /* clinical worklists, observation tables, and side-panel cards */ /* visually instrument-like and align edges to a 2px grid.

selector.$description: Inner padding hints for selectors and fields — compressed so */ /* checklist rows and field grids pack tightly.

border.$description: Border width: 1px hairline, matching `$nhsuk-border-width-form`. */ /* The hairline is the smallest legible border on the LCDs used in */ /* clinical settings; going to 0.5px loses the edge on non-Retina */ /* workstation displays still common in NHS estate.

depth.$description: Depth & noise off — NHS Scotland identity guidance, like NHS UK, */ /* avoids shadows, gradients, and textures so the interface looks */ /* clinical, calm, and easy to read on low-end devices common in */ /* community health settings.
